RecordsApprovalPoliciesLayout.title: Approval policies
RecordsApprovalPoliciesLayout.description: Decide when generated documents need internal approval before they go out.

ApprovalPoliciesBrowser.title: Approval policies
ApprovalPoliciesBrowser.emptyBody: Policies route generated quotes, proposals, order forms, and contracts for internal approval — by document type, total value, or discount depth — before they can be finalized.

ApprovalPolicyDialog.description: Documents matching this policy must be approved before they can be finalized.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.currencyRequired: A currency is required when a total threshold is set.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.thresholdHint: With no thresholds, every matching document requires approval. With thresholds, approval is required when any one is reached. Totals only compare within the policy's currency — add one policy per quoted currency.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.pendingApprovalsUnchanged: Pending approvals continue unchanged under their frozen chain.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.sodStrict: anyone but the requester and author decide
ApprovalPolicyDialog.stepDueIntervalHint: Leave blank to keep this step open until it is decided.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.stepDueIntervalInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 8,760.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.chainEmptyBody: One approval from anyone who can approve documents.
ApprovalPolicyDialog.impactTitle: This change invalidates approvals in flight
ApprovalPolicyDialog.impactBody: {count, plural, one {# approval is pending under this policy.} other {# approvals are pending under this policy.}}
ApprovalPolicyDialog.impactConsequence: Tightening a policy cannot rewrite a request that is already frozen, so these requests end instead. Each document returns to draft and has to be sent for approval again under the new chain. Decisions already recorded are kept.
